entities.summary: Yuxiong, also known as Yuzi or Master Yu, was an early ruler of the ancient Chinese state that was later known as Chu. He was an ally and teacher of King Wen of Zhou, the first king of the Zhou dynasty. In the Tsinghua Bamboo Slips his name is written as Xuexiong.
